items.title: P&G CFO on Q4 earnings: Consumers are 'responding to innovation'
items.summary: Procter & Gamble (PG) stock takes a dip on Wednesday after missing fourth quarter revenue expectations ($21.2 billion vs. estimates of $21.38 billion). P&G CFO Andre Schulten speaks with Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi about the latest trends in consumer buying and whether North American shoppers reflect those trends.
